# Code of Conduct

## Our Pledge

In the interest of fostering an open, technical, and constructive engineering environment around **Computer Evolution Lab**, contributors and participants pledge to keep all discussions, bug reports, and technical reviews respectful, factual, and harassment-free regardless of background or experience level.

## Expected Standards

- Focus critiques strictly on hardware accuracy, simulator math, graphics fidelity, performance, and code clarity.
- Provide reproducible steps (machine ID, assembly/GLSL snippet, browser & GPU renderer) when reporting defects.
- Respect authorship, attribution, and the non-commercial terms documented in `LICENSE`.

## Enforcement

Unacceptable behavior, personal attacks, or bad-faith disruption may be moderated or removed by the project maintainer (**0thernes LLC**, `0_0@0thernes.art`).
